discovery_extension.purpose: Include material new events published after the Sep 9 raw input without rewriting the identity or cardinality of the locked source input.

discovered_missing_candidates.headline: Hyundai Motor Group, LG Energy Solution, Hyundai Engineering and Wonik PNE launch 200kWh used-EV-battery UBESS demonstration
discovered_missing_candidates.incremental_signal: The parties began validation of a 200kWh UBESS linked to EV fast charging, using used E-GMP battery packs; this is an operational pilot rather than a generic circular-economy plan.
discovered_missing_candidates.notes: Strong candidate. Preserve exact pilot scale and participant roles; do not generalize pilot validation into commercial deployment.

discovered_missing_candidates.headline: Volvo Group plans large-scale battery storage facility and future energy-solution test bed in Mariestad, Sweden
discovered_missing_candidates.incremental_signal: Volvo Group disclosed a new stationary battery-storage and test-bed initiative at Mariestad, creating a distinct energy-infrastructure use case around its electrification footprint.
discovered_missing_candidates.notes: Potentially material but exact MW/MWh, timing, ownership and investment need Stage B sourcing if selected.

discovered_missing_candidates.headline: Jinko ESS signs Middle East C&I distribution agreement with Innovative Efficient Solutions for SunGiga G2 systems
discovered_missing_candidates.incremental_signal: Jinko ESS appointed IES as an authorized distributor for SunGiga G2 C&I storage solutions in the Middle East, with local execution support from Ruya Energy.
discovered_missing_candidates.notes: Retain in discovery universe, but no disclosed contract volume or project capacity means independent cardability may be capped.
